import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix species case variant (chinstrap -> Chinstrap)
    df = df.copy()
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip().str.title()
    
    # Fix island extra spaces
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    
    # Fix out_of_range body_mass_g values (clip to allowed range 2500-6500)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].clip(lower=2500, upper=6500)
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Count penguins by island
    island_counts = df.groupby('island').size().to_dict()
    return island_counts
